scripts.build:npm: node source/scripts/write-version.mjs && rm -rf ./dist && esbuild source/Index.tsx --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --minify --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' && esbuild source/mcp/index.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --minify --outfile=dist/mcp.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node'
scripts.build:binary: npm run build:sea:bundle && npm run build:sea
scripts.test:e2e:ci: npm run build:npm && vitest run source/test/e2e
scripts.test:e2e: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -v /app/node_modules -w /app epiq-e2e npm run test:e2e:ci
scripts.pack:check: rm -f epiq-*.tgz && npm pack && FILE=$(ls -t epiq-*.tgz | head -n 1) && echo "$FILE" && tar -tf "$FILE"
scripts.publish:dry: rm -f epiq-*.tgz && npm pack && FILE=$(ls -t epiq-*.tgz | head -n 1) && npm publish --dry-run "$FILE"
scripts.publish:tarball: FILE=$(ls -t epiq-*.tgz | head -n 1) && echo "Publishing $FILE" && npm publish "$FILE"
scripts.release: npm run pack:check && npm run publish:tarball
